title: 건널목 개량촉진법 시행령 / queue:ANNEX:0002:00:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Railroad Crossing Improvement Promotion Act [Attached Table 2]

Road Traffic Volume Conversion Rates (Related to Article 2, subparagraph 6)

Category | Conversion Rate | Subject
1. Pedestrian | 1 |
2. Bicycle | 2 |
3. Carts drawn by persons or livestock, etc. | 3 |
4. Motor vehicle
- Two-wheeled vehicle | 4 | Motorized bicycle, cultivator, electric wheelchair, etc.
- Small-sized | 8 | Passenger car, small passenger vehicle (15 persons or fewer), small truck (gross weight 3.5 tons or less)
- Medium-sized | 10 | Medium passenger vehicle (16 to 35 persons), medium truck (over 3.5 tons and under 10 tons), small special motor vehicle (gross weight 3.5 tons or less), construction machinery (gross weight 3.5 tons or less)
- Large-sized | 12 | Large passenger vehicle (36 persons or more), large truck (gross weight 10 tons or more), medium/large special motor vehicle (gross weight over 3.5 tons), construction machinery (gross weight over 3.5 tons)

Note: For subparagraphs 2 and 3, riders or persons pulling the vehicle are included and shall not be counted separately as pedestrians.
